records.text: Jolene completed an electrical engineering project during the week of 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-22 after putting in a lot of work.
Deborah visited her deceased mother's old house during the week of 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-22; the house holds many memories for Deborah.
Deborah's mother died a few years before 2023-01-23.

Deborah shared a photograph described as the last photo of Deborah and Deborah's mother together; the photo shows two women in wheelchairs hugging, one identified by context as Deborah and the other as Deborah's mother.
Jolene's mother died in 2022.
Jolene shared a photograph of a room in her deceased mother's house; the room contains a bench and a window, and Jolene has many memories there.
Deborah's mother's house had a special bench near a window where Deborah's mother loved to sit every morning and take in the view.
Deborah sometimes sits on the bench near the window in her mother's house because it helps Deborah feel connected to her mother.
Jolene owns a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it that her mother gave Jolene in Paris in 2010.
The symbol on Jolene's pendant represents freedom to Jolene.
Jolene views the pendant's freedom symbol as a reminder to pursue her goals and avoid being held back.
Deborah also has a pendant that reminds Deborah of her mother, though no design or origin details were given.
Deborah wants to continue teaching yoga and supporting her community.
Deborah is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga.
Yoga helped Deborah find peace during a difficult period, which inspired Deborah to share yoga with other people.
Deborah and Jolene met for the first time on 2023-01-23 and expressed interest in having another chat.

On 2023-01-25, Deborah's father died suddenly. As of 2023-01-27, Deborah said his death had left the family shell-shocked and that she was coping by spending more time with family, cherishing memories, and trying to live life fully.
On 2023-01-27, Deborah shared a photo depicting a woman hugging another woman who was sitting on a couch, in the context of discussing her father's death and family support.
On 2023-01-27, Deborah and her family looked through a family album after her father's death; Deborah said photos give her peace during difficult times.
Deborah's parents were married in 1993; on 2023-01-27 Deborah shared a photo of her parents posing as bride and groom and described them as a beautiful couple through Jolene's response.
Deborah said on 2023-01-27 that she and her husband are trying to be as good a family as Deborah's parents were.
Deborah values love, openness, and being there for each other in her relationship with her husband; she said these qualities have kept them close and made both of them happy over the years.
On 2023-01-26, Deborah received a note from members of her yoga group thanking her for the positive influence she had on them. Deborah shared a photo of the handwritten note on 2023-01-27.
The thank-you note from Deborah's yoga group reminded Deborah why she is passionate about yoga and wants to have a positive influence on group members.
Deborah practices yoga in the living room of her old home, shown in a shared photo with a television and a window. She visits the old home occasionally because it belonged to her deceased mother.
At Deborah's old home, sitting in the spot by the window gives Deborah peace and makes her feel her deceased mother's presence; Deborah considers the spot special and comforting.

On 2023-01-27, Deborah shared a photo of a window seat in a room at her old home. Deborah said her deceased mother used to sit there every night with a book and a smile, because reading was one of her mother's hobbies, and that the seat was one of her mother's favorite places in the house.
Travel was one of Deborah's deceased mother's great passions, in addition to reading.
On 2023-01-27, Deborah shared a photo showing a view of the sky through an airplane window while discussing her deceased mother's passion for travel.
Jolene owns a snake named Susie. Jolene said her snakes calm her down and make her happy, and on 2023-01-27 she shared a photo of Susie's head sticking out from a bed.
Jolene said that while she was playing video games, her snake Seraphim escaped from her cage, slinked over, and coiled up next to her; Jolene found the incident funny.
Jolene owns a second snake named Seraphim; on 2023-01-27 she shared a photo of Seraphim's head emerging from a blanket and commented on Seraphim's sly eyes.
On January 27, 2023, Jolene said that she had bought an unspecified item in Paris about a year earlier.
On January 27, 2023, Deborah remarked that pets bring a great deal of happiness.
On January 27, 2023, Jolene described her pets as very unusual pets.
During the week before January 27, 2023, Jolene and her partner played the console game "Detroit" together. Jolene said they are both crazy about gaming.
On January 27, 2023, Jolene shared a photo depicting a person lying in bed while a dog watched television.
Jolene said she learned to play video games on her own as a child, rather than being taught by her boyfriend.
Deborah asked Jolene whether Jolene plays only old video games or also tries new games.
Jolene and her unnamed boyfriend are planning to play "The Walking Dead" video game on Saturday, February 4, 2023.
Deborah and Jolene exchanged friendly farewells on January 27, 2023; Deborah encouraged Jolene to take care and keep spreading good vibes, and Jolene thanked Deborah and reciprocated the well-wishes.

On February 1, 2023, Jolene said her engineering professor assigned a huge robotics project. Jolene described the project as tough but fun because it required creativity and problem-solving; a shared photo showed a robot on a table beside a laptop.

On February 1, 2023, Jolene said she initially felt both excited and nervous about the robotics project, but she now enjoys solving the design and programming challenges and finds it awesome and satisfying to see the robot come together.
On January 31, 2023, Deborah met her new neighbor Anna at yoga in the park. Deborah and Anna discussed how yoga had improved their lives and provided a sense of community.
On February 1, 2023, Deborah shared a photo of a yellow sign displaying a picture of a family while telling Jolene about meeting her new neighbor Anna.
On February 1, 2023, Jolene shared a photo showing a purse with a plant on a table.
On February 1, 2023, when Deborah asked whether Jolene had considered resuming yoga, Jolene said that she and her partner had planned to play a console together instead.

On February 1, 2023, Deborah encouraged Jolene about having a shared activity with her partner, and Jolene thanked Deborah for the kind words. Deborah and Jolene ended the conversation with friendly farewells.
On February 4, 2023, Jolene said she had been on an emotional rollercoaster recently but was coping.
During the week preceding February 4, 2023, Jolene reached a major engineering milestone that went very well, leaving her relieved and proud; she described it as a huge accomplishment.

During the week preceding February 4, 2023, Jolene planned and researched extensively to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. She found the difficult project rewarding and loved the experience.

When Jolene saw the sustainable water purifier working and providing clean water to the rural community, she felt the moment was surreal and incredibly satisfying. The experience reminded Jolene that engineering can improve people's lives and gave her a sense of purpose and having done something good.

Jolene wants to continue working in engineering and create sustainable solutions that positively affect communities in need. Jolene's career goal is to help make the world a better place through her work.
Deborah teaches yoga and spends much of her time teaching it; Deborah says yoga helps people find balance and reconnect with themselves.
On February 3, 2023, Deborah bonded with her new neighbor Anna during a yoga class.
On February 4, 2023, Deborah shared a photo showing Deborah and Anna as two women in a dance studio performing a dance pose.

During the February 3, 2023 yoga class, Deborah and Anna tried different dance poses, including Warrior II, which Deborah said builds strength and boosts focus. Deborah also shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair.
Deborah and Anna supported each other while practicing yoga and dance poses, which brought them closer; Deborah said their mutual support meant a lot to her.
On February 4, 2023, Jolene asked Deborah to explain how to perform the yoga pose Deborah and Anna had been practicing.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah explained a modified seated twist: sit on the edge of a chair with feet planted, twist the torso to one side, use a hand on the knee for support, hold for a few breaths to stretch the back and shoulders, then switch sides; Deborah said it helps relax tense muscles.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene shared a photo of her bookshelf, which contained a large collection of books.

On 2023-02-04, Jolene said she was really enjoying Yuval Noah Harari's book "Sapiens," especially its discussion of human history and technology's effects on humanity; the book was giving her a lot to think about.
Around 2023-01-21, Jolene read Neal Stephenson's "Avalanche" in one sitting; on 2023-02-04 she told Deborah about this reading experience.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene said a recent story about a person who became successful despite numerous challenges showed her that anything is possible through belief and hard work.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah shared a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table. Deborah said a friend gave her the bouquet while Deborah was struggling, and that seeing it gives her hope and courage and fills her with warmth and appreciation.
Deborah's favorite nature places include a park with a forest trail, where she finds getting lost in nature calming, and a nearby beach, where waves and sand make her feel peaceful and happy.

During summer 2022, Jolene took a vacation photo in Bogotá showing a person walking on a beach with a surfboard; Jolene said watching the sunset over the water was beautiful and calming and deepened her appreciation of nature's calming power.

Deborah likes visiting a spot by the water near her deceased mother's former house to reflect on her mother's life and find peace; on 2023-02-04 Deborah shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water and described nature there as helpful for reflection.

Deborah keeps an amulet from her mother and brings it whenever she visits the reflective waterside spot; on 2023-02-04 Deborah shared a photo showing a woman in a white shirt wearing the amulet as a gold chain necklace. Deborah said holding it makes her feel her mother's love, stay close to her, and feel comforted.
Deborah said on 2023-02-04 that her friend Anna also wears a pendant in memory of Anna's mother, and that this shared memorial practice brought Deborah and Anna closer.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah encouraged Jolene to endure life's difficulties, look to her sources of strength, care for herself, and stay in touch; Jolene said Deborah's encouragement meant a lot and promised to stay in touch.
On 2023-02-08, Jolene completed a mini retreat to assess her life, describing it as a powerful experience that gave her a new outlook.
On 2023-02-08, Jolene felt that she had achieved more than expected during her mini retreat, which significantly boosted her confidence.
During her mini retreat on 2023-02-08, Jolene made meaningful progress on her engineering project by developing several solutions that excited her.
Jolene believes green technology could make a significant difference in disadvantaged areas and wants to investigate ways to contribute.
Jolene is considering creating a volunteer program in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged children.

Jolene is considering partnering with local schools and community centers to run STEM workshops for underprivileged children, with engineers invited as guest speakers to show students possible career paths.

As of 2023-02-09, Jolene had not contacted any schools or community centers about the proposed STEM volunteer program because she wanted to solidify the plan first; Jolene was eager to begin outreach.
On 2023-02-09, Jolene shared a photo of her planner sketches: a notebook with a pen beside another notebook open to a page of notes, apparently related to her STEM outreach ideas.
On 2023-02-09, Deborah encouraged Jolene's reflection, engineering work, and proposed STEM outreach program, while Jolene thanked Deborah for her support and called Deborah awesome.
On 2023-02-21, Jolene had a night out with friends involving dinner and drinks; she felt excited and relieved to let her hair down. Jolene shared a photo showing a plate of food and a glass of wine.

On 2023-02-22, Deborah visited a calming, nostalgic garden containing flowers in buckets and shared a photo of it. Roses and dahlias brought Deborah peace while she coped with the loss of a friend who died the previous week.
Deborah lost a friend during the week of 2023-02-13 to 2023-02-19 and found comfort by remembering their time together; the memories reminded Deborah how special life is.

Deborah's deceased friend was named Karlie. The last photo Deborah had with Karlie was taken in summer 2022 during a hiking trip; the photo showed Deborah and Karlie riding a motorcycle on a dirt road. Deborah remembered that they had a great time and smiled whenever she saw the photo.

Deborah considers Bali one of her favorite places. She visited Bali in 2022 and found the island gorgeous, peaceful, and especially well suited to yoga. Deborah shared a photo of a swing on a beach under a blue sky.
Deborah enjoys yoga outdoors, particularly on a beach; she values the sound of waves and fresh air during beach yoga.
Jolene wants to try yoga on the beach and said she would let Deborah know if she decides to go; Deborah encouraged Jolene to enjoy it and keep her posted.
Jolene expressed empathy for Deborah's bereavement and agreed that memories can provide comfort and joy.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene said she is balancing engineering school with her male partner's video-game playing while setting aside personal time for yoga and meditation.
Jolene said yoga helps her calm down, gain perspective, become more alert and motivated, and manage the craziness of engineering school and her relationship.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene shared a photo showing a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose; the woman was presented as Jolene.
Jolene's male partner sometimes joins her for yoga, which Jolene said is relaxing, supports bonding, and has brought them closer.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene shared a random photo showing a man and a woman holding hands, with rings visible on their hands.

Jolene and her male partner have been together for three years as of 2023-02-25, are not married, are taking the relationship slowly, and enjoy the journey. A ring on the man's hand is decorative and is not a wedding ring.
Jolene and her male partner met in an engineering class in college, became friends quickly, and later developed a romantic relationship.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene shared a photo showing a book and a calculator on a table.
Jolene and her male partner still work together on engineering projects; Jolene values that they understand each other's struggles and both enjoy the projects.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene shared a photo showing a group of men standing in front of a building, apparently in connection with engineering project work.
When Jolene feels overwhelmed, she takes a break to do breathing exercises or meditate; these practices make her feel calmer and clearer and help her handle challenges more easily.
On 2023-02-25, Jolene thanked Deborah for her support and said she would keep pushing forward while continuing to make time for herself.
On 2023-02-25, Deborah shared a photo of a person sitting on a bench and looking at a sunset while reflecting outdoors; Deborah described it as a reminder to find peace amid chaos.

Deborah's morning routine includes meditation, yoga, and teaching yoga classes. On 2023-02-24, Deborah went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park and decided to incorporate jogging into her daily routine.

Deborah considers exercise essential because it makes her feel connected to her body. She believes self-care replenishes the energy needed to help others, expressed by the saying, "Can't pour from an empty cup."
Deborah spends evenings with loved ones and encouraged Jolene to listen to her heart, take care of herself, and remember that she is worth prioritizing.

Jolene is an engineering student with a robotics project and a male partner. As of 2023-02-25, Jolene and her partner have been together three years, are not married, and met in a college engineering class; they sometimes do yoga and engineering projects together. Jolene uses yoga, breathing, and meditation to manage stress. Deborah teaches yoga, meditates, jogged for the first time on 2023-02-24, and plans to make jogging part of her routine. Deborah supports Jolene's self-care. Photos shown: Jolene doing yoga; Jolene and partner holding hands with decorative rings; a book and calculator; men by a building; Deborah's outdoor sunset reflection.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah said Anna had recently brought her a vegan stir-fry made with tofu, vegetables, ginger, and soy sauce, which Deborah found tasty and nourishing.
Jolene considers lasagna one of her favorite comfort dishes and said comfort food can cheer someone up.
Jolene is occupied with studies, exams, deadlines, and a seemingly endless to-do list, and she feels overwhelmed by the workload.
On 2023-02-24, Jolene practiced yoga and meditation as personal time to relax; she said the quiet moments helped her soul and Deborah said the same practice helped Deborah reset her mind.
On 2023-02-24, Jolene shared a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window while discussing her yoga and meditation time.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene shared a photo of a purse with a plant on a table while reflecting on quiet moments and self-care.
On 2023-02-26, Jolene took Seraphim, her tamed snake, to a park; Jolene said Seraphim enjoyed the outing and they explored new places together.

On 2023-02-26, Jolene shared a park photo showing an animal identified in the photo description as a lizard lying on the ground amid leaves; Jolene described Seraphim as a tamed snake and said people are surprised to see one.
Deborah enjoys being outdoors because she likes hearing birds chirp and feeling a gentle breeze; these experiences remind Deborah of what matters.
Jolene believes time outdoors can remind a person to slow down and appreciate little things.
Jolene wants to be more mindful of her stress levels and mental health because she sometimes becomes so focused on studies that she neglects self-care.

Deborah advised Jolene to divide her academic work into smaller pieces, set goals, and use a planner or scheduler to stay organized and preserve personal time; Deborah offered to help Jolene create a study plan.
Deborah plans to give Jolene an encouraging yellow mug like the one shown in the shared photo, which had a handwritten message on it.
Deborah encouraged Jolene not to give up, wished Jolene good luck with exams, and reminded Jolene to make time to relax; Jolene said Deborah's support cheered her up.
On March 10, 2023, Deborah hosted a yoga class for interested neighbors in her neighborhood and shared a photo showing a group of women posing together.

By March 13, 2023, Deborah had started teaching a neighborhood yoga class, allowing her to exercise with neighbors, help them experience positive transformation, and build community connections and friendships.
Deborah finds yoga calming and feels very happy when sharing peace and awareness with other people; Deborah considers teaching yoga rewarding because it helps others and strengthens community.
On March 13, 2023, Jolene told Deborah that Jolene was having difficulty managing Engineering assignments, was struggling to keep up, and wanted to continue discussing time management.
On March 13, 2023, Deborah and Jolene agreed to find a mutually convenient time to discuss Jolene's time management; Jolene planned to check her schedule and contact Deborah afterward.
On March 13, 2023, Deborah offered emotional support to Jolene during Jolene's academic stress, encouraged Jolene to take care of herself, and said Deborah was available if Jolene needed her.
On March 22, 2023, Jolene said that managing exams, deadlines, projects, and other responsibilities felt stressful and like constantly playing catch-up.
On March 22, 2023, Jolene said she was using the Pomodoro Technique—25 minutes of work followed by a 5-minute break—to avoid burnout, but she was still struggling to prioritize tasks.
On March 22, 2023, Deborah said she creates a daily schedule or to-do list and shared a photo of a notepad containing a list of things to do.

On March 22, 2023, Jolene said that making a task list felt overwhelming when she had a large stack of tasks, and she shared a photo of a notepad with notes on it lying on a counter; Jolene also said it was often difficult to know where to start.

On March 22, 2023, Deborah introduced Jolene to the Eisenhower Matrix, explaining that it sorts tasks into four boxes according to urgency and importance to help organize and prioritize work; Deborah shared a photo of scissors on top of a piece of paper showing the method.
On March 22, 2023, Jolene said the Eisenhower Matrix visualization was helpful and agreed to try it in hopes of staying focused and becoming less stressed; Jolene thanked Deborah for the help.

On March 22, 2023, Deborah encouraged Jolene to take things easy, look after herself, pursue her goals, and take progress step by step while having fun; Jolene responded appreciatively and felt supported.
Recently before March 22, 2023, Deborah and Anna sat by the sea watching the sunset and talking about each other, and Deborah and Anna realized that they inspire each other.

On March 22, 2023, Deborah shared a photo of a person walking on a beach with a surfboard and asked Jolene what thoughts the sea in the photo evoked; Jolene said the image made Jolene think about learning to surf and needing to find spare time.

Jolene wants to learn to surf. By March 22, 2023, Jolene had gathered information, watched surfing videos, obtained a beginner's guide to surfing, and planned to find a suitable time and place for a surfing lesson.

On March 22, 2023, Deborah shared a photo of a row of surfboards leaning against a palm tree while encouraging Jolene to believe in herself and take the first steps toward learning to surf; Jolene said the photo motivated Jolene to keep pushing toward that goal.

On Friday, March 24, 2023, Jolene had a breakthrough in her engineering project by finding a solution to a problem that had been troubling her; Jolene felt great seeing her hard work pay off. Jolene shared a photo of a person's hand holding a pair of scissors.
On March 28, 2023, Deborah said she had bought new props for her yoga class and shared a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a room.
On March 28, 2023, Jolene said she had new details for a case and asked Deborah to rate it; Jolene shared a photo of a cardboard mat with a cup of coffee on it.
On March 28, 2023, Deborah said she bought a candle with a sprig of rosemary to improve the atmosphere and her yoga practice, and shared a photo of the candle on a table.
Jolene feels relaxed during yoga and enjoys creating a serene space with soothing scents such as lavender and rosemary.
Deborah likes using candles and essential oils during yoga because their scents add warmth and calm and help create a peaceful state.
Jolene finds that music enhances her yoga practice and listens to Nils Frahm and Ólafur Arnalds because their music is calming and puts her in a different headspace.
Deborah prefers instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms for a peaceful yoga atmosphere; one favorite track is called "Savana."
Deborah listens to the album "Sleep" for meditation and deep relaxation and recommended it to Jolene.
Jolene plans to check out Deborah's music tips, including the album "Sleep," for new music to use during yoga.
Deborah encouraged Jolene about Jolene's engineering breakthrough, praised Jolene's skills, and encouraged Jolene to keep up the good work.
On April 2–8, 2023, Deborah went biking nearby with her neighbor and found the experience freeing and beautiful.
On April 9, 2023, Deborah visited an art show with a friend and found the artwork cool and inspiring. Deborah shared a photo showing a large brown-and-white image of a person.
Deborah's mother was interested in art and believed art could evoke strong emotions and create unique connections between people. Deborah's mother is deceased.
Attending art shows helps Deborah feel as though she is still experiencing art together with her deceased mother; Deborah finds this painful but comforting.
Deborah finds peace by keeping her deceased mother's memory alive, and she finds solace and powerful emotional reminders of loved ones through artwork and other things she loves.
Jolene keeps snakes. Although Jolene's snakes cannot chat or understand what Jolene is experiencing, spending time with them is valuable and teaches Jolene to slow down and be in tune with herself.
Jolene relaxes by playing video games with her partner after a long day, and she feels these shared activities bring them closer together.
As of April 9, 2023, Jolene was working on a large project that was difficult but exciting to watch take shape, and she planned to update Deborah on its progress and final result.
Deborah offers Jolene ongoing emotional support, and Jolene told Deborah that Deborah's support means a lot to her. Deborah said she would always be there for Jolene.
Deborah values simple activities and comforts that bring happiness and help during difficult times, while Jolene intends to make time for activities that bring her joy.
In May 2023, Jolene completed a difficult engineering project and shared a photo of the result: a solar-powered vehicle with a solar panel on its back.
Jolene feels proud of herself for persevering through problems and finishing the engineering project, which she considers a major milestone.
After completing the engineering project, Jolene began an internship at a well-known engineering firm to test her skills and gain real-world experience.
Jolene shared a photo of her new colleagues at the engineering firm; the photo shows a group of construction workers posing together.
Jolene says the best part of her internship is applying what she learned in school to real projects and seeing her ideas come to life, which she finds fulfilling.
Jolene says her internship has positively affected her life, strengthened her love of engineering, and encouraged her to keep pursuing her dreams.
Jolene feels inspired by spending time with people who love their work; this has helped her stay focused on her goals and believe that dedication and effort can make anything possible.
Jolene has found it difficult to maintain work-life balance during her internship because she has been working hard and has little time for hobbies and relaxation.
On June 5, 2023, Jolene practiced yoga on top of Mount Talkeetna and shared a photo depicting a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched.
Jolene has practiced yoga and meditation sporadically for about three years as of June 6, 2023.
Jolene says yoga and meditation have had a strongly positive effect, helping her manage stress and remain centered; she says she does not know how she would have coped without them.
Deborah shared a photo of her favorite yoga studio, showing a calming room with a bench and a window.
Deborah considers the yoga studio shown in her shared photo her favorite studio and finds it consistently calming.
Jolene is trying to take breaks and make time for relaxing activities such as yoga during her internship.
Jolene asked Deborah for advice on calming her mind and breathing during yoga.

Deborah recommended that Jolene practice mindful breathing for yoga by sitting with her eyes closed for a few minutes each day, taking deep breaths, and focusing on the sensation of air entering and leaving her body.
Jolene appreciated Deborah's mindful-breathing advice and said she would definitely try it.
Deborah offered to provide Jolene with more tips or help if needed.
On June 6, 2023, Jolene said goodbye to Deborah at the end of their conversation.
Deborah was preparing for an upcoming yoga retreat with friends who share her interest in peace, understanding, reflection, and mindfulness.
Deborah shared a photo showing a group of people practicing yoga in a park.
Jolene said that her internship and other responsibilities had been extremely hectic, and that she could use a break.
Deborah practiced Dancer Pose, also called Natarajasana, and shared a photo of a woman performing a yoga pose on a beach.
Jolene owns a female snake named Seraphim. Jolene shared photos of Seraphim curled up in a plant-filled area inside a new aquarium that Jolene bought on June 24, 2023.
Jolene got Seraphim in 2022. Jolene considers Seraphim a great pet that cheers Jolene up, brings peace, and provides comfort; Jolene is thankful to have Seraphim as a calm creature nearby.
Deborah is strongly drawn to animals and feels that pets make life more enjoyable and brighter.
Jolene said that life had been intense because Jolene was pushing hard to succeed; Jolene sometimes felt overwhelmed but was determined to overcome obstacles and achieve goals.
Jolene reported a major breakthrough in a project and described the result as exciting and rewarding. Jolene shared a photo showing a drawing of a house with a ruler and another ruler.
Deborah shared a photo from the retreat showing three people standing in front of a large statue after trying Tree Pose.
Deborah said the large statue in the retreat photo symbolized peace and enlightenment.
Jolene expressed interest in visiting a retreat like Deborah's because it seemed ideal for finding peace, refreshment, reflection, and centeredness; Jolene said Jolene needed peaceful time to relax.
Deborah values peaceful time for relaxation and getting centered.
Deborah shared a photo showing a sunset reflecting in a lake with a boat.

On July 9, 2023, Deborah told Jolene that she started a running group with Anna, describing it as an excellent way to connect with people who care about fitness. A shared photo showed three men standing together on a road.
Jolene is trying to add workouts to her studying schedule; she finds doing so difficult but enjoyable.

Deborah's running group helps members push and encourage one another during runs, making it easier for Deborah to stay motivated. Deborah has many photos from the activity; one shared photo showed a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard.

Jolene has a romantic partner who is also interested in gaming. Jolene's partner helps Jolene stay focused on their goals, and Jolene and the partner have cute photos together; one showed a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer.

Jolene enjoys gaming with her partner because they tackle challenges together, share experiences, achieve difficult goals, and bond. Their favorite cooperative game is "It Takes Two," which Jolene described as fun, team-strategy-oriented, and competitive.

Deborah enjoys running and practicing yoga and meditation with other people. Deborah also loves organizing workshops and events focused on mindfulness and self-care; one shared photo showed a group of people doing yoga in a park.

Deborah's workshops and events include yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. Their goals are to cultivate self-awareness, support mental and emotional well-being, help people find inner peace, and provide a space for connection, exploration, and personal growth.

Deborah feels honored and rewarded by seeing people come together, support one another, and experience growth and transformation through her workshops. A shared photo showed a game board covered with cards.
Jolene was fascinated by reptiles and felt that a snake was the perfect pet for her. Caring for her snake is calming and helps Jolene connect with nature.

Jolene recalled that her female snake Seraphim once escaped, leading Jolene to search for hours. Jolene eventually found Seraphim snuggled under the bed and felt intense relief, love, gratitude, and a deeper realization of how important Seraphim is to her. A shared photo showed a snake in a tank with sand and plants.
Deborah has cats and dislikes dogs. Deborah introduced the cats to Jolene through a shared photo showing two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket.

Deborah considers exercise and nature very important and says that nature helps her find peace, refreshment, perspective, and time for reflection. Deborah said she takes her cats out for a run in the park every morning and evening. A shared photo showed a person walking on a beach with a surfboard.

Jolene enjoys going for walks when possible to take in her surroundings and photograph nature. Jolene shared a photo of a sunset over a body of water and agreed that nature can bring peace and clarity.
On July 9, 2023, Jolene shared a photo showing a dock on a peaceful lake surrounded by trees.
Jolene considers the lake location a hidden gem and says it makes her feel peaceful and tranquil; she uses it to relax and tune out.
Jolene proposed that Jolene and Deborah visit the peaceful lake location together sometime.
Deborah said that everyone needs a timeout, agreeing with the idea of taking time to relax.
On 2023-08-01, Deborah told Jolene that Deborah had started a community cleanup project and was raising funds for it. Deborah was encouraged by the community coming together to make a difference.

Around the week before 2023-08-01, Jolene experienced a major setback with Jolene's project: after investing substantial effort, the project crashed and Jolene lost everything. Jolene described the experience as extremely frustrating and depressing.
When Jolene is struggling, Susie provides significant emotional support and companionship. Jolene also finds comfort in pets generally and uses video games as a distraction.
